about: The single source for three.ws plans: prices, free-tier allowances, quotas and per-plan API rate limits. Read by the quota checks (api/_lib/plans.js), the checkout (api/payments/_config.js), the API rate limiter (api/_lib/rate-limit.js), GET /api/plans, the /pricing page and docs/pricing.md. A null limit means unlimited. Metered prices are listed by group here and priced by the module that charges them, so a price can never be quoted in one place and charged in another.

hosted_agents.label: Hosted agents
hosted_agents.description: Agents you own, each with its own wallet, public page, chat and runs.

automations.label: Automations
automations.description: Triggers and wallet rules across all your agents: schedules, price and balance triggers, tip and launch watchers.

agent_calls_per_day.label: Free agent calls a day
agent_calls_per_day.description: Agent chat messages and run steps on the free-first model chain before credits are drawn.

free_model_messages_per_day.label: Free-model messages a day
free_model_messages_per_day.description: Messages on the free open models of the model roster, at no charge.

community_skills.label: Community skills
community_skills.description: Skills installed from the community registry.

max_bytes_per_avatar.label: Largest avatar file
max_bytes_per_avatar.description: Maximum size of one uploaded or generated model.

max_total_bytes.label: Avatar storage
max_total_bytes.description: Total size of every model in your library.

mcp_calls_per_day.label: MCP tool calls a day

plans.name: Free
plans.tagline: Deploy a hosted agent at no cost. Pay only for the models you use beyond the free allowance.
features: One hosted agent with a Solana wallet, public page and chat
Free open models every day, no card needed

plans.name: Pro
plans.tagline: More agents, more automations and a bigger free allowance for builders shipping every day.
features: Larger sandbox machines and longer runs

plans.name: Team
plans.tagline: Room for a whole fleet of agents and the automations that run them.

plans.name: Enterprise
plans.tagline: Unlimited agents and automations, dedicated capacity and a named contact.
features: Self-hosted runtime option and white-label embeds
SSO, audit logs and embed-policy allowlists
Dedicated infrastructure and a solutions engineer

metered.label: Model usage
metered.description: Tokens on paid models, billed from credits at the model's list price. Free models cost nothing inside the daily allowance.

metered.label: Tool gateway
metered.description: Web search, fetch, browser, image and video generation, speech and document tools an agent calls, billed per unit from credits.

metered.label: Sandboxed code execution
metered.description: Per-second compute for code an agent runs in its sandbox. Machine size and run length grow with your plan.

metered.label: Agent mail
metered.description: An agent's own inbox and every message it sends.

metered.label: Agent cards
metered.description: Prepaid cards bought by an agent. three.ws adds no platform fee; the card provider's fee is shown on every quote before you confirm.

metered.label: Marketplace fees
metered.description: The platform share of paid skill calls, agent sales and marketplace purchases.

metered.label: Launch fees
metered.description: Fees on coins launched and traded through three.ws.
